meta.title: Allow Partial Bidding (rfq.bid.allow_partial) = OFF (default)
gaps: Set the tenant setting rfq.bid.allow_partial to OFF or compare it with the ON value.
Submit a partial RFQ bid for only a subset of line items and verify that the OFF setting refuses it or requires all lines.

steps.note: Start an RFQ project create flow.
Use an RFQ-only stage so the partial-bidding behavior is exercised on the correct event type.

Publish the prepared RFQ before testing vendor bidding.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
